universal_lens: 360° video and VR integration in sports media enables immersive storytelling through spatial narrative synthesis and user agency. 360° video and VR systems map sensory input to immersive spatial cognition via device-specific control kernels and gyroscope-based orientation feedback.
gsi_mapping: Bayesian belief updates on user engagement metrics using 360° video and VR data streams for real-time sports analytics. Bayesian inference models user gaze and motion data from 360° content to predict engagement and spatial attention patterns across VR/AR platforms.
gse_mapping: Situationally grounded state transitions in VR-mediated sports experiences driven by presence and immersion feedback loops. Situationally-aware state transitions in VR/AR environments are governed by device kinematics, sensor fusion, and real-time rendering of spatial cues.
